About me

I’m Matt Sim — a solo founder since 14, with 13+ years in esports and 15+ hackathon wins in a year. Today I’m building Operator Uplift on Solana, making native content, and taking the work wherever a backpack and a 2019 MacBook can go.

Let’s build something

What I do

  1. 01

    Protocol & product building

    Turning an idea into a working product. I’m building Operator Uplift on Solana and working across the protocol, product, and founder journey.

  2. 02

    Native short-form content

    Interviews, founder stories, and short-form video made for the feed. Raw conversations, a clear hook, and an edit that gets to the point.

  3. 03

    Event coverage

    On-the-floor interviews, activation coverage, and recaps that bring the energy of an event to people who couldn’t be there.

  4. 04

    Community & esports

    Thirteen-plus years in esports, bringing a competitor’s mindset to the communities, conversations, and products I help build.

  5. 05

    Brand partnerships

    Connecting products with builders through native content, event presence, and a founder’s perspective. Let’s make something people actually want to watch.
